rows.note: This is the all-purpose way to say that someone or something disappoints a person.

example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 go3 biu2 jin2 ling6 ngo5 sat1 mong6

rows.jyutping: gu1 fu6 A ge3 kei4 mong6
rows.note: Use this when the focus is on failing to live up to A's expectations or hopes.

example.english: This report did disappoint me by falling short of my expectations.
example.traditional: 呢份報告辜負咗我嘅期望。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 gu1 fu6 zo2 ngo5 ge3 kei4 mong6
